decisions.rationale: Gastric outlet obstruction is a manifestation of superior mesenteric artery syndrome.
Peptic stricture of the stomach is not directly related to superior mesenteric artery syndrome.
Neoplasm of the stomach is not directly related to superior mesenteric artery syndrome.
Annular pancreas, diabetic gastroparesis, internal hernia, and duodenal bezoar are alternative causes, not directly related to superior mesenteric artery syndrome.
Peptic ulcer disease and duodenal tumors are not directly related to superior mesenteric artery syndrome.
Scleroderma and other collagen or vascular disorders are not directly related to superior mesenteric artery syndrome.
Vascular compression due to a reduced aortomesenteric angle is a subtype of superior mesenteric artery syndrome.
